description: Technology definitions. 'historical_year' = first significant practical adoption (not first invention), used by the SAME era-cost rule in both modes: research cost is multiplied by (1 + max(0, historical_year - current_year) / 12)^2 (quadratic since TECH-01). Pioneers can therefore adopt earlier than history at a steep cost, but not leap decades ahead. Prerequisites and diffusion from neighbours/trade partners also apply in both modes. TECH-01 (2026-11-22): entries with a 'source' field come from the CG-28 catalogue (docs/research/history/CG28_TECH_CATALOGUE.csv); 'tfp' effects are project design weights for endogenous productivity (src/engine/systems/growth.ts), not historical data.
